verificationScript:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,datetime
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); d=root/'docs/internal/extensions/native1'
def h(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest().upper()
def git_bytes(*args): return subprocess.run(['git',*args],check=True,capture_output=True).stdout
old=git_bytes('show','fa79233f77acbfa0470ef6203131e66784c7b014:docs/internal/extensions/native1/ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md')
new=git_bytes('show','52ba2a57784c1dcd234615821865b87fd31b2d31:docs/internal/extensions/native1/ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md')
assert new.startswith(old), 'An earlier matrix byte was changed'
assert new==(d/'ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md').read_bytes(), 'Matrix changed after source freeze'
assert h(new[:28298])=='0A5D2313CCEC30DE81AAB3B19439247C612CE4B8FC6C19C0BF51F6C3809D103E'
index=json.loads((d/'AUDIT_PACKET_INDEX.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert index['targetCommit']=='52ba2a57784c1dcd234615821865b87fd31b2d31'
for pin in index['metadata']+index['selectedRawReceipts']:
    raw=(d/pin['path']).read_bytes(); assert len(raw)==pin['bytes'] and h(raw)==pin['sha256'], pin['path']
report=(d/'REPORT.md').read_bytes()
assert report.startswith(b'Status: CANDIDATE_COMPLETE\nI found no assigned or inherited acceptance criterion unmet; coordinator acceptance is still required.\n')
assert b'52ba2a57784c1dcd234615821865b87fd31b2d31' in report
record=dict(schema='native1-final-freeze-v1',passed=True,checkedUtc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),sourceCommit=index['targetCommit'],priorMatrixBytes=len(old),priorMatrixSha256=h(old),allPriorMatrixBytesPreserved=True,frozenPrefixBytes=28298,frozenPrefixSha256=h(new[:28298]),matrixBytes=len(new),matrixSha256=h(new),packetMetadataPins=len(index['metadata']),rawReceiptPins=len(index['selectedRawReceipts']),packetPinsMatch=True,reportBytes=len(report),reportSha256=h(report),verificationScript=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
(d/'commands/final-freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k!='verificationScript'},indent=2))
